title: Place, Slice and Schedule: Hierarchical O-RAN Control of a Tethered mmWave UAV-gNB
abstract: arXiv:2608.23824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-mounted 5G New Radio base stations (gNBs) can augment terrestrial networks with an on-demand, repositionable Frequency Range 2 (FR2) capacity layer. This flexibility, however, couples the physical network topology with radio-resource management: UAV movement reshapes blockage, channel quality, and the set of effectively served users, while traffic demand, queues, and service requirements evolve at a much faster timescale. translated_title: 位置、切片与调度：系留毫米波无人机gNB的分层O-RAN控制
translated_abstract: 摘要：搭载5G新无线电基站（gNB）的无人机可以按需提供可重新定位的频率范围2（FR2）容量层，以增强地面网络。然而，这种灵活性将物理网络拓扑与无线资源管理耦合在一起：无人机的移动会改变阻塞、信道质量和实际服务的用户集合，而流量需求、队列和服务要求在更快的时间尺度上演变。现有的开放无线接入网（O-RAN）无人机研究优化了轨迹、部署、关联或资源分配，但通常孤立进行，未将慢速空中控制与快速每用户调度协调起来。相反，我们利用O-RAN解耦、关键绩效指标（KPI）监控和多时间尺度RAN智能控制器（RIC）控制来解决这一耦合问题：非实时RIC rApp使用聚合KPI和无线环境上下文，联合优化无人机位置、网络切片和调度策略。
tldr: 本文提出一种分层O-RAN控制框架，通过非实时RIC协调无人机位置、切片和调度，解决了系留毫米波无人机基站中慢速空中控制与快速用户调度之间的耦合问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical O-RAN control framework that coordinates UAV placement, slicing, and scheduling via a non-real-time RIC, addressing the coupling between slow aerial control and fast per-user scheduling in tethered mmWave UAV-gNBs.
